work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Epistle CCLXXXIII (OCR CCLXXXII.) to Gregory Peter VI, patriarch of Cilicia of the Armenians (address LF48674–48675, protocol LF48678), answers his report, refers jurisdictional complaints to earlier apostolic letters and his requests to Propaganda, and ends with its own closing kalendis decembris 1833 at LF48719–48721, before numeral CCLXXXIV at LF48724. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF48678–48678; the source closing at LF48719–48721 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum kalendis de- cembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno tertio. The block LF48690–48697 holds CCLXXXII's note 1, this epistle's note 2 (Ex Iure Pont. de P. F.) and page number 318. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
